limitations: CraftedNBA credits no measurement source and doesn't say whether heights are with or without shoes; its values are labelled reported, never combine-measured.
Reported values stay out of percentiles, positional averages and the registered correlations.
The combine's measurement wins wherever a player has both.
Names are matched to NBA person IDs; a name that fits several players and can't be settled by DARKO's board on the seal date is left out and listed.
source.name: CraftedNBA, Height and Wingspan for every player in the NBA
